Description: As a subscriber, I want to swap monthly box items before the fulfillment deadline so that my shipment matches my preferences.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: The selected items are updated and the fulfillment manifest is refreshed. Fail: Customization is locked before the 48-hour deadline.

Description: As a subscriber, I want to select products from the available monthly products so that the customized monthly box includes my choices.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: Selected products are saved and displayed in the monthly box. Fail: A selected product is not saved.

Description: As a subscriber, I want to add, remove, or update preference tags so that future product recommendations reflect my preferences.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: Updated tags are saved and reflected in the next product recommendations/selections. Fail: Changes are not saved.

Description: As a subscriber, I want to pause my subscription so that deliveries are stopped for the paused period.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: The subscription is marked paused and no recurring shipment is scheduled during the paused period. Fail: A shipment remains scheduled while the subscription is paused.

Description: As a subscriber, I want to skip a selected billing cycle before the monthly renewal date so that no box is scheduled for that cycle.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: The selected cycle is marked as skipped and no box is scheduled for that cycle. Fail: The cycle remains scheduled.

Description: As a subscriber, I want to update my shipping details so that future subscription boxes are delivered to the current address.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: The updated shipping details are saved and applied to future shipments. Fail: The shipping details are not saved or applied.

Description: As the payment gateway, I want to process monthly subscription billing so that eligible subscriptions are charged for their monthly cycle.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: Eligible subscriptions are billed and the payment result is recorded. Fail: Billing is not processed for an eligible subscription or the result is not recorded.

Summary: Generate fulfillment manifest for the current cycle
Description: As a fulfillment lead, I want the system to generate a manifest containing all eligible scheduled boxes for the current billing cycle.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: The manifest contains all eligible scheduled boxes for the cycle. Fail: Eligible boxes are missing.

Description: As a fulfillment lead, I want shipping labels generated for the fulfillment manifest so that scheduled boxes can be shipped.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: A shipping label is generated for each eligible box in the manifest. Fail: Any eligible box is missing a shipping label.

Description: As a fulfillment lead, I want shipment labels exported within 60 seconds under the specified load so that fulfillment operations are benchmarked and remain timely.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: Benchmarking confirms export completes in less than 60 seconds under the specified load. Fail: Export takes 60 seconds or more.

Description: As a subscriber, I want unauthenticated users blocked from subscriber-specific information and authenticated users limited to their own authorized data.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: Unauthenticated users cannot access subscriber-specific data; authenticated users can access only authorized data. Fail: Protected data is accessible without authentication.
